method: All archive JPG entries grouped by CRC32 and uncompressed byte size; only repeated-metadata candidates were read from extracted files and SHA-256 compared. Images were not decoded for this duplicate scan.
limits: This detects byte-identical duplicates only; near-duplicates and re-encoded copies are not checked.
Original images were retained and no labels were changed.
Final split assignment must keep each identical-content group within one split; conflicting labels require a consistent treatment before freezing splits.
